verdict.rationale: Meta's safety blog says users can freely inspect, edit and download all files in their Muse VM, including everything Muse generates or uses on their behalf and its memory about them. That is a real but partial data-export path. The activity log and audit trail can be viewed in-app, but nothing says they can be exported. Missing for 10: an explicit chat-history export, a full account-data export or takeout tool, export of the activity log or audit trail, and independent or hands-on confirmation that downloads are complete.
